description: Columbia University Synthetic Power Grid with Geographical Coordinates is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Saleh Soltan, Alexander Loh (Electrical Engineering Department at Princeton University). The following data set is generated based on the statistical properties of the US Western Interconnection. This data set consists of four tables, each contained in a single comma-delimited CSV file. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1 .zip with 5 .csv; 506 KB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
